profile_intro: These details are stored only in this browser and used for your invoices. There is no user account or invoice archive.

profile_required_guidance: Required fields are marked with *. A German VAT ID consists of DE followed by nine digits; a tax number can be provided instead.

profile_delete_description: Previously downloaded PDFs will not be deleted.
profile_deleted_draft_retained: Invoice inputs are retained in this tab.
profile_delete_failed: The profile could not be deleted from this browser.

profile_storage_failure_title: The profile could not be saved

profile_vat_id_invalid: A German VAT ID starts with DE followed by nine digits.
